Your key responsibilities

  • As a painter, you will be responsible for painting, decorating, and minor repair work throughout the hotel as well as in the staff housing, ensuring that all areas consistently meet our high standards.

  • You will carry out high-quality interior and exterior painting and decorating work, including the professional preparation of surfaces through filling, sanding, priming, painting, and coating.

  • You will perform regular inspections and touch-up work in guest rooms, bathrooms, public areas, and back-of-house spaces to maintain an impeccable appearance and ensure the highest quality standards.

  • You will carry out minor repair and maintenance work on walls, ceilings, woodwork, and other painted or coated surfaces, selecting and using appropriate materials and techniques.

  • You will work closely with the Technical Services team and support painting, decorating, and finishing work during renovations, seasonal preparations, special projects, and events.

  • You will ensure that all work is carried out efficiently, safely, and with particular attention to detail, while minimising disruption to our guests and hotel operations.

  • You will take on occasional on-call duty shifts to respond quickly and reliably to emergencies as they arise.

• What you bring to the job

For this highly varied position, you ideally bring the following:

  • Completed vocational training as a painter, decorator, or an equivalent professional qualification.

  • Several years of professional experience in painting, decorating, renovation, and maintenance work. Previous experience in a luxury hotel or a comparable high-standard environment is an advantage.

  • Strong technical knowledge of painting and decorating techniques, surface preparation, coatings, materials, and finishes, combined with a high standard of craftsmanship.

  • Good command of German as well as spoken Italian; knowledge of English is an advantage.

  • A responsible, reliable, and independent working style, with excellent attention to detail and a strong commitment to maintaining the highest quality standards.

  • A professional and discreet approach, particularly when working in guest-facing areas and occupied spaces, with consideration for our guests and hotel operations at all times.

  • A flexible and solution-oriented mindset, together with the ability to remain reliable and efficient during busy periods.

Our offer

  • Permanent full-time position in St. Moritz.

  • Average 5-day working week with 43.5 working hours.

  • 5 weeks of vacation and 6 public holidays per year.

  • 13th salary from the start date (pro rata temporis).

  • Accommodation in one of our new staff houses at the beginning upon request.

  • Meals available in our new and modern staff restaurant.

  • Opportunity to work in an attractive environment with development and career growth opportunities.

If you are looking for an interesting, challenging, and varied role in a dynamic environment and would like to join a well-established team, we look forward to receiving your complete online application.


Recruitment Fraud Warning

Badrutt's Palace Hotel will never request payment or financial information during the recruitment process. All official communication is sent exclusively from email addresses ending in @badruttspalace.com. If you receive any request for payment or suspicious communication, please disregard it and contact us directly through our official website.

En tant que vérificateur de nuit, vous êtes une personne-ressource importante pour nos invités internationaux pendant la nuit et vous assurez que les processus de la réception et les normes de service et de qualité élevées sont bien fonctionner.

Ils complètent notre équipe de Front Office et sont responsables des tâches suivantes:

- Vous recevez nos invités internationaux de façon professionnelle et chaleureuse, effectuez des check-in et check-out et prenez soin de vos demandes et souhaits individuellement.

- Ils garantissent un service de première classe pendant la nuit selon les standards élevés d'un hôtel 5 étoiles international de luxe.

- Vous assumerez les tâches au bureau principal, à la caisse enregistreuse et au bureau de back office et vous serez responsable de la réalisation des comptes de la journée ainsi que du contrôle des réservations, des transactions et des caisses enregistreuses.

• Votre profil

Pour cette position très variée, vous apportez idéalement les éléments suivants :

- Formation complète dans l'hôtellerie ou dans une école hôtelière.

- Au moins 2-3 ans d'expérience professionnelle au front office, idéalement comme auditeur de nuit ou dans une position comparable dans l'industrie hôtelière de luxe 5 étoiles.

- Très bonne connaissance des procédures opérationnelles et administratives de la réception.

- Expérience des comptes courants, de la gestion de la trésorerie et du contrôle des transactions de front office

- La flexibilité et la bonne connaissance des processus de travail dans la zone de la réception.

- Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais, de l'italien ou du russe.

- Bonnes compétences informatiques des programmes MS Office.

- Des manières impeccables et une apparence bien entretenue.

- Un haut niveau d'engagement, de flexibilité et de joie dans le travail de nuit.

- Une forte orientation de l'équipe et en même temps la capacité de prendre des décisions de façon indépendante.

Notre offre

- Position temporaire de saison de fin novembre 2026 jusqu'à fin mars 2027.

- En moyenne, 5 jours par semaine à 43,5 heures.

- 5 semaines de vacances et 6 jours fériés par an.

13. Rémunération par entrée (par taux de temporis).

- Sur demande au début de l'hébergement dans une de nos nouvelles maisons de staff.

- Nourriture dans le nouveau restaurant moderne du personnel.

- Travailler dans un environnement attrayant avec des opportunités de développement.

Si vous appréciez une activité intéressante, exigeante et polyvalente dans un environnement dynamique et que vous souhaitez rejoindre une équipe bien formée, nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature complète en ligne.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Le vostre responsabilità chiave

- La vostra esperienza nella preparazione e presentazione del sushi e sashimi nel rinomato stile Matsuhisa, nel pieno rispetto dei nostri standard qualitativi, vi distingue.

- Create nuovi panini e piatti di sushi, migliorando continuamente e evolvendo il nostro menù.

- Lei consiglia e si impegna con i nostri ospiti presso il sushi banco appositamente progettato all'interno della nostra cucina open show.

- Garantire la pulizia e l'igiene in cucina in conformità con gli standard HACCP è una delle vostre responsabilità fondamentali.

• Cosa si porta al lavoro

- Formazione professionale completata come Sushi Chef (certificato richiesto).

- Almeno 8 anni di esperienza professionale come Sushi Chef (riferiti richiesti), tra cui un minimo di 1 anno.s esperienza in una delle operazioni di ristorante NOBU / Matsuhisa.

- Resilienza e flessibilità per prosperare in un ambiente dinamico.

- Ottimo lavoro di squadra e capacità comunicative.

- Un alto livello di attenzione ai dettagli e precisione nella preparazione dei piatti.

La nostra offerta

- Posizione stagionale a tempo determinato dalla fine di novembre 2026 alla fine di marzo 2027.

- Lavorare in media per 5 giorni, in base a 43,5 ore.

- Cinque settimane di ferie e sei giorni festivi all'anno.

- 13o mese di stipendio dalla data di inizio (pro rata temporis).

- Alloggio in una delle nostre residenze per il personale su richiesta.

- Possibilità di pranzo nel nostro nuovo, moderno ristorante personale.

Se apprezzi un ruolo interessante, impegnativo e vario in un ambiente dinamico e desideri unirti a un team ben coordinato, non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua applicazione online completa.

Avviso sulle frodi in materia di assunzione

Il Badrutt's Palace Hotel non richiederà mai il pagamento o informazioni finanziarie durante il processo di reclutamento. Tutte le comunicazioni ufficiali vengono inviate esclusivamente da indirizzi e-mail che terminano in @ badruttsgalace.com. Se ricevi qualsiasi richiesta di pagamento o comunicazione sospetta, ti preghiamo di ignorarlo e contattarci direttamente attraverso il nostro sito ufficiale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Your key responsibilities

  • Your expertise in the preparation and presentation of sushi and sashimi in the renowned Matsuhisa style, in full compliance with our quality standards, sets you apart.

  • You create new sushi rolls and dishes, continuously enhancing and evolving our menu.

  • You advise and engage with our guests at the specially designed sushi counter within our open show kitchen.

  • Ensuring cleanliness and hygiene in the kitchen in accordance with HACCP standards is one of your key responsibilities.


• What you bring to the job

  • Completed professional training as a Sushi Chef (certificate required).

  • At least 8 years of professional experience as a Sushi Chef (references required), including a minimum of 1 year’s experience in one of the NOBU / Matsuhisa restaurant operations.

  • Resilience and flexibility to thrive in a dynamic environment.

  • Excellent teamwork and communication skills.

  • A high level of attention to detail and precision in the preparation of dishes.


Our offer

  • Fixed-term seasonal position from the end of November 2026 until the end of March 2027.

  • Five-day working week on average, based on 43.5 hours.

  • Five weeks of holiday and six public holidays per year.

  • 13th month salary from the start date (pro rata temporis).

  • Accommodation in one of our attractive staff residences upon request.

  • Dining options in our new, modern staff restaurant.

If you value an interesting, demanding and varied role within a dynamic environment and would like to join a well-coordinated team, we look forward to receiving your complete online application.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

Badrutt's Palace Hotel will never request payment or financial information during the recruitment process. All official communication is sent exclusively from email addresses ending in @badruttspalace.com. If you receive any request for payment or suspicious communication, please disregard it and contact us directly through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your key responsibilities

You will complement our Housekeeping team and be responsible for the following areas:

  • In close collaboration with the Executive Housekeeper, you will lead a team of approximately 70 Room Attendants and Floor Porters.

  • You will actively contribute to staff scheduling and help ensure the smooth and efficient running of daily operations.

  • • Your responsibilities will include inspecting arrival, stayover and departure rooms, as well as checking VIP setups, public areas and staff accommodation.

  • You will organise and order the materials required for daily operations and ensure that all deliveries meet our quality standards and are complete.

  • Through targeted training and continuous guidance, you will support the professional development of our employees and ensure compliance with our quality and hygiene standards.

  • You will act as a competent point of contact for our guests, responding to questions and individual requests while ensuring attentive and personalised service.

• What you bring to the job

For this varied and rewarding position, you ideally bring the following qualifications and experience:

  • You have completed professional training in the hotel industry and have gained relevant experience in a five-star hotel environment.

  • You have previous leadership experience and are confident in supporting the Executive Housekeeper with the management and coordination of a large team.

  • You have a very good command of written and spoken German, as well as good spoken English and Italian.

  • You are proficient in the use of standard Microsoft Office applications. Knowledge of Protel and Mirus would be an advantage.

  • You demonstrate a high level of initiative and commitment, combined with a strong focus on quality and guest satisfaction.

  • Your confident and well-groomed appearance, together with your excellent manners and interpersonal skills, complete your profile.

Our offer

  • Fixed-term seasonal position from mid-November 2026 until the beginning of April 2027

  • 5-day working week averaging 43.5 hours, with 5 weeks' holiday and 6 public holidays per year.

  • 13th month's salary from the start of employment (pro rata temporis).

  • Accommodation in one of our new staff houses.

  • Meals available in our new and modern staff restaurant.

  • Opportunity to work in an attractive environment with development and career growth opportunities.

If you appreciate an interesting, challenging and varied role in a dynamic environment and would like to join a well-established team, we look forward to receiving your complete online application.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

Badrutt’s Palace Hotel will never request payments or financial information as part of the recruitment process. All official communication is conducted exclusively through email addresses ending in @badruttspalace.com.

Should you receive a payment request or any suspicious communication, please disregard it and contact us directly through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your key responsibilities

As a valued member of our Purchasing team, you will be responsible for a diverse range of tasks across the Receiving & Stores operation.

  • You inspect all incoming deliveries against purchase orders and delivery notes, ensuring compliance with our quality standards.

  • Whenever required, delivered goods are stored appropriately and in accordance with established procedures.

  • All ordered goods are checked for completeness, and you liaise with suppliers whenever discrepancies arise.

  • Delivery notes are processed and posted accurately and in a timely manner.

  • Responsibility for issuing stores requisitions to our internal departments forms an integral part of your role.

  • Internal stock transfers relating to stores issues are recorded accurately and systematically.

  • By monitoring inventory levels and placing replenishment orders independently, you help ensure the continuous availability of goods.

  • In addition, you oversee the organisation of the receiving area, including the garage, storage rooms, empty containers, packaging, cleanliness, and materials management.

• What you bring to the job

  • You have completed vocational training as a Chef or a Restaurant Professional.

  • Previous experience in an administrative role enables you to work in a structured, organised, and conscientious manner.

  • You are proficient in Microsoft Office applications, with advanced skills in Microsoft Excel.

  • Ideally, you have experience working with an inventory management system; knowledge of Kost is considered an advantage.

  • You have an excellent command of written and spoken English; additional knowledge of Italian or German is an asset.

  • A high level of commitment, resilience, and the ability to grasp new concepts quickly enable you to work independently and in a solution-oriented manner.

  • A professional appearance and courteous, friendly manner complete your profile.

Our offer

  • Fixed-term seasonal position from the end of November 2026 to the end of February 2027

  • Average 5-day working week with 43.5 working hours.

  • 5 weeks of vacation and 6 public holidays per year.

  • 13th salary from the start date (pro rata temporis).

  • Accommodation in one of our staff houses.

  • Meals available in our modern staff restaurant.

  • Opportunity to work in an attractive environment with development and career growth opportunities.

If you are looking for an interesting, challenging, and diverse role in a dynamic environment and would like to join a well-established and collaborative team, we look forward to receiving your complete online application.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

Badrutt's Palace Hotel will never request payment or financial information during the recruitment process. All official communication is sent exclusively from email addresses ending in @badruttspalace.com. If you receive any request for payment or suspicious communication, please disregard it and contact us directly through our official website.

Your key responsibilities

In this responsible position, you will work closely with the Director of Commercial Strategy and our external Revenue Management Consultant, actively contributing to the strategic pricing and optimal market positioning of our property.

  • You will develop and manage seasonal pricing strategies for rooms and suites to maximize revenue, average rate and occupancy.

  • You will prepare the room revenue budget in collaboration with the Director of Commercial Strategy.

  • Through accurate forecasting, detailed market and trend analyses, and data-driven decision-making, you will continuously optimize the performance of all relevant distribution channels.

  • Prepare regular Business-on-the-Books analyses, pick-up reports, and forecasts, including comparisons with budget and previous year figures to support strategic decision-making.

  • You will develop guidelines for the ideal segment and channel mix and adjust the sales strategy when necessary in order to proactively respond to market trends.

  • Plan and coordinate tactical promotions and sales activities to support room revenue objectives, while actively monitoring the hotel’s reservation strategy and overbooking situation.

  • You will prepare and lead the weekly Revenue Strategy Meeting.

  • In close cooperation with the Sales team, you will manage group pricing and evaluate business opportunities to maximize profitability.

  • Maintain regular alignment and communication with the Reservations team.

  • Prepare statistical reports and analyses for the monthly closing report, as well as the Revenue Management section of the annual Sales & Marketing Plan.

  • Monitor and update the Revenue Management System (currently Duetto) to ensure it is managed in accordance with company best practices.

• What you bring to the job

  • Several years of experience in Revenue Management within upscale or luxury hospitality environments; experience in Reservations and Front Office operations is considered an advantage.

  • Strong ability to effectively analyse and interpret operational, financial, and marketing data.

  • Solid understanding of distribution channels, channel management, and reservation systems.

  • Excellent organisational and communication skills, with the ability to respond flexibly and proactively to market changes.

  • Advanced knowledge of relevant Revenue Management and PMS systems; experience with Protel, Duetto, and IDeas is highly preferred.

  • Excellent command of written and spoken English; German language skills are considered an advantage.

Our offer

  • Permanent full-time position in St. Moritz.

  • Average 5-day working week with 43.5 working hours.

  • 5 weeks of vacation and 6 public holidays per year.

  • 13th salary from the start date (pro rata temporis).

  • Accommodation in one of our new staff houses at the beginning upon request.

  • Meals available in our new and modern staff restaurant.

  • Opportunity to work in an attractive environment with development and career growth opportunities.

We look forward to getting to know you and receiving your complete online application.

Your key responsibilities

As Head of Technical Services, you hold overall responsibility for the strategic and operational management of all technical areas within our property. In this key position, you ensure not only the flawless operation, safety, and preservation of our infrastructure, but also actively shape its ongoing development.

  • Overall responsibility for the technical operations and the entire infrastructure of the property, ensuring the highest standards of quality, safety, and efficiency.

  • Strategic planning and implementation of maintenance, investment, and renovation projects.

  • Responsibility for budgeting and cost control within the technical department, including long-term investment planning.

  • Leadership, development, and organisation of the technical team, with a focus on clear structures and solution-oriented working methods.

  • Selection, management, and supervision of external service providers and contractors.

  • Further development and implementation of initiatives in energy efficiency, sustainability, and resource management.

  • Ensuring compliance with all legal requirements, safety standards, and internal policies.

  • Close collaboration with all departments to ensure smooth operations and continuous optimisation of processes.


• What you bring to the job

  • Solid technical training, complemented by further education in building services engineering, facility management, or related disciplines.

  • Extensive leadership experience at a senior management level in comparable structures, ideally in the technical management of complex building infrastructures within the hospitality sector.

  • In-depth technical expertise in building services, energy efficiency, safety, occupational health and safety, and digital infrastructure.

  • Proven experience in leading and delivering investment, renovation, or construction projects.

  • Experience working with modern ERP/CAFM systems and digital tools for managing, documenting, and optimising technical processes.

  • Strong leadership personality with excellent communication skills and a systems-oriented mindset.

  • High resilience and a goal-oriented approach in a dynamic and complex environment.

  • A combination of at least two of the following languages is required: English, German, and Italian.

  • Please note: You must be a Swiss or EU national to apply for this position.


Our offer

  • A year-round leadership position within one of the most renowned luxury hospitality brands worldwide.

  • The opportunity to actively shape and further develop the technical direction of a property with international prestige—defined by the highest standards of quality, substance, and excellence.

  • A responsible key role with a tangible impact on the guest experience, as well as on the sustainable development and positioning of the property.

  • An environment focused on long-term thinking, continuity, and development at leadership level.

  • Attractive employment conditions in line with the scope and responsibility of the position.

If you are looking to take on an influential leadership role in an exceptional luxury hospitality environment and wish to actively contribute to the technical advancement of an internationally renowned property alongside a dedicated and experienced team, we look forward to receiving your complete online application.

  • Support the Stewarding Manager in overseeing the stewarding operation across all hotel areas, ensuring high standards of cleanliness, hygiene, and organisation.

  • Act as deputy in the absence of the Stewarding Manager, ensuring continuity of operations and consistent leadership.

  • Lead and coordinate the stewarding team during assigned shifts, ensuring tasks are completed efficiently and to standard.

  • Assist in staff scheduling and daily workforce planning to ensure effective operational coverage.

  • Ensure the availability and proper handling of equipment and materials for kitchens, service areas, and events.

  • Collaborate closely with kitchen and service teams to maintain smooth and well-coordinated operations.

  • Monitor stock levels of detergents and consumables, supporting cost control and avoiding shortages.

  • Ensure compliance with HACCP and internal standards, while identifying opportunities to improve processes and organisation.

• What you bring to the job

  • Previous supervisory experience in stewarding, cleaning operations, or a similar role within hospitality.

  • Ability to lead a team during shifts, providing clear direction, support, and motivation.

  • Strong sense of responsibility, organisation, and attention to detail.

  • Ability to perform well under pressure while maintaining quality and efficiency.

  • Good communication skills in Portuguese and/or Italian and English.

  • Comfortable using basic computer systems (e.g. scheduling tools, stock control, internal systems).

  • Swiss or EU citizenship required due to work permit regulations.

Our offer

  • Fixed-term contract of 10 months, with the possibility of returning for future seasons

  • 5-day working week, averaging 43.5 hours

  • 5 weeks of holiday and 6 public holidays per year

  • 13th month salary from the start of employment (pro rata)

  • Accommodation in one of our modern staff houses

  • Meals available in our contemporary staff restaurant

  • A career in an attractive environment with opportunities for development

If you enjoy a varied and responsible role within a dynamic team and would like to contribute your experience and motivation, we look forward to receiving your complete online application.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

Badrutt's Palace Hotel will never request payment or financial information during the recruitment process. All official communication is sent exclusively from email addresses ending in @badruttspalace.com. If you receive any request for payment or suspicious communication, please disregard it and contact us directly through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Was Sie bei uns bewirken

  • Als Director of Brand & Marketing tragen Sie die Gesamtverantwortung für Marke und Marketing des Badrutt’s Palace über alle Touchpoints hinweg – Hotel, Restaurants, Bars, Spa, Retail und Events.

  • Sie entwickeln Positionierung, Markenbild, Tonalität und visuelle Identität konsequent weiter und sichern einen stimmigen, hochwertigen Markenauftritt.

  • Sie führen das Brand- und Marketingteam mit hohem Anspruch an Markenverständnis, kulturelle Sensibilität und Exzellenz.

  • Die gesamte digitale Präsenz der Marke steuern Sie über alle relevanten Kanäle hinweg. Dazu zählen Website Experience, Social Media, Content, Paid Media sowie SEO/GEO/SEM.

  • Sie entwickeln die eigenständige Social- und Content-Handschrift des Hauses weiter. Kulturelle Relevanz und ein klar definierter Luxus-Code stehen dabei im Fokus.

  • Sie verantworten das CRM als zentrales Beziehungs- und Wertschöpfungsinstrument im Luxussegment.

  • Relevante KPIs definieren, überwachen und steuern Sie als Grundlage für Transparenz und nachhaltige Wirkung.

  • Sie führen externe Partner und Agenturen mit klarem Qualitätsanspruch.


Das bringen Sie mit

Für diese sehr abwechslungsreiche Position bringen Sie idealerweise folgendes mit:

  • Ausgeprägtes Gespür für Ultra Luxury, Ästhetik, Sprache und Markenwirkung auf höchstem Niveau.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer leitenden Brand- und/oder Marketingfunktion im Premium- oder Luxusumfeld.

  • Nachweisliche Führungserfahrung auf Management- oder Geschäftsleitungsebene.

  • Umfassende digitale Kompetenz in Social Media, Content, Performance, Web und CRM.

  • Ausgeprägtes unternehmerisches Denken sowie hohe Entscheidungs- und Umsetzungskraft.

  • Souveräner Umgang mit internen und externen Senior Stakeholdern.

  • Sehr hohe Sprachkompetenz in Englisch, Deutsch von Vorteil..

  • Bereitschaft für ein anspruchsvolles, saisonales Umfeld.


Unser Angebot

  • Eine unbefristete Jahresstelle in einer der seltensten Brand-Rollen der internationalen Luxushotellerie.

  • Mitglied des Executive Committees (Excom) mit direktem Einfluss auf Marke und Gästeerlebnis.

  • Die Möglichkeit, in einem Haus mit globaler Strahlkraft zu wirken, geprägt von höchstem Qualitätsanspruch, Kultur und Exzellenz.

  • Ein attraktives Arbeitsumfeld in St. Moritz mit langfristiger Perspektive und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten auf Executive-Level.

Wenn Sie diese aussergewöhnliche Führungsaufgabe im internationalen Luxusumfeld anspricht, freuen wir uns auf Ihre vollständige Online-Bewerbung.

Warnhinweis vor Recruiting-Betrug

Das Badrutt’s Palace Hotel wird im Rahmen des Rekrutierungsprozesses niemals Zahlungen oder finanzielle Informationen verlangen. Die gesamte offizielle Kommunikation erfolgt ausschliesslich über E-Mail-Adressen mit der Endung @badruttspalace.com.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Was Sie bei uns bewirken

Sie ergänzen unser Room Service Team als Assistant Room Service Manager und tragen massgeblich dazu bei, dass unsere Gäste einen exzellenten und reibungslosen Service auf höchstem Niveau erleben.

  • Sie nehmen mit Ihrem ausgeprägten Fachwissen telefonische Bestellungen entgegen und beraten unsere internationalen Gäste professionell und kompetent.

  • Sie begeistern unsere Gäste dank Ihrer Erfahrung und Ihres umfassenden Produktwissens und stellen sicher, dass höchste Qualitätsstandards jederzeit eingehalten werden.

  • Sie unterstützen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Room Service Manager die Organisation des täglichen Betriebs, koordinieren Arbeitsabläufe und stellen sicher, dass Gästewünsche sowie spezielle Anweisungen präzise umgesetzt werden.

  • Sie unterstützen den Room Service Manager bei der Führung des Teams, helfen bei der Einsatzplanung der Mitarbeitenden, wirken bei der Organisation von Trainings mit und tragen aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung des Teams bei.

  • Sie motivieren mit Ihrer Leadership-Kompetenz das Team, fördern eine positive Arbeitsatmosphäre und gehen mit gutem Beispiel voran.

  • Sie stellen sicher, dass Bestellungen sowie Abrechnungsinformationen korrekt aufgezeichnet und dokumentiert werden, um Transparenz und Effizienz zu gewährleisten.

  • Sie bewahren auch in hektischen Zeiten einen kühlen Kopf und gewährleisten gemeinsam mit dem Team einen reibungslosen Ablauf des Room Service – auch während der Stosszeiten.


Das bringen Sie mit

Für diese verantwortungsvolle und vielseitige Position bringen Sie idealerweise folgendes mit:

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Restaurationsfachmann/-frau oder vergleichbare Ausbildung in der Hotellerie/Gastronomie.

  • Mindestens 4-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Room Service oder F&B Bereich in der 5 Hotellerie*.

  • Sehr gute Fachkenntnisse im klassischen à la carte Service.

  • Erste Führungserfahrung oder Erfahrung in einer stellvertretenden Funktion von Vorteil.

  • Sehr gute mündliche Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch, weitere Sprachen wie Italienisch sind von Vorteil.

  • Ausgeprägte Leadership- und Organisationsfähigkeiten.

  • Hohes Mass an Engagement, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Qualitätsbewusstsein.

  • Teamplayer mit der Fähigkeit, auch in hektischen Situationen strukturiert und lösungsorientiert zu arbeiten.

  • Sehr gute Umgangsformen sowie ein gepflegtes und professionelles Erscheinungsbild.

Unser Angebot

  • 10-Monats-Vertrag

  • 5-Tage Woche im Schnitt bei 43,5 Stunden

  • 5 Wochen Ferien und 6 Feiertage pro Jahr

  • 13. Gehalt ab Eintritt (pro rata temporis)

  • Auf Wunsch zu Beginn Unterkunft in einem unserer schönen Mitarbeiterhäuser

  • Verpflegungsmöglichkeit in unserem neuen, modernen Mitarbeiter Restaurant

  • Arbeit in einem attraktiven Umfeld mit Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Wenn Sie eine vielseitige, verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen Team schätzen und sich mit Ihrer Erfahrung und Motivation einbringen möchten, freuen wir uns auf Ihre vollständige Online-Bewerbung.

Als Guest Experience Executive sind Sie ein wichtiger Bestandteil unseren Gästen aussergewöhnliche und unvergessliche Momente zu bereiten. Mit einem feinen Gespür für individuelle Wünsche, einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch und echter Leidenschaft für erstklassigen Service gestalten Sie jeden Aufenthalt zu einem besonderen Erlebnis.

  • Sie stehen bereits vor der Anreise sowie während des gesamten Aufenthalts in engem Kontakt mit unseren Gästen, um ein erstklassiges Gästeerlebnis und individuell abgestimmte Services sicherzustellen.

  • Sie arbeiten eng mit verschiedenen Abteilungen zusammen und gewährleisten so eine reibungslose und effektive Kommunikation.

  • Über unser Messaging System betreuen Sie Gästeanfragen schnell, diskret und professionell und sorgen dafür, dass sich unsere Gäste jederzeit bestens umsorgt fühlen.
    Dabei zeichnen Sie sich durch ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Menschen sowie eine starke Team- und Lösungsorientierung aus.

Für diese vielseitige Position bringen Sie idealerweise folgendes Profil mit:

  • Sie verfügen über eine Berufsausbildung in der Hotellerie oder abgeschlossene Hotelfachschule.

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung am Front Office und/oder in der Reservierung und/oder in der Conciergerie in der Luxushotellerie.

  • Sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch; Italienisch und weitere Sprachen sind von Vorteil.

  • Idealerweise verfügen Sie über Erfahrung im Umgang mit Systemen wie Concierge Organizer, Protel und Aleno oder vergleichbaren Tools und sind versiert in der professionellen E-Mail- und Telefonkorrespondenz mit internationalen Gästen auf 5-Sterne-Niveau.

  • Sehr gute EDV-Anwenderkenntnisse.

  • Proaktiver Arbeitsstil sowie ein hohes Mass an Engagement und Verantwortungsbewusstsein.

  • Ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Menschen, Teamfähigkeit und Lösungsorientierung.

  • Souveränes Auftreten sowie gepflegte Umgangsformen.

Unser Angebot

  • Eine unbefristete Position

  • 5-Tage Woche im Schnitt bei 43,5 Stunden

  • 5 Wochen Ferien und 6 Feiertage pro Jahr

  • 13. Gehalt ab Eintritt (pro rata temporis)

  • Auf Wunsch zu Beginn Unterkunft in einem unserer schönen Mitarbeiterhäuser

  • Verpflegungsmöglichkeit im neuen, modernen Mitarbeiter Restaurant

  • Arbeit in einem attraktiven Umfeld mit Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Das Badrutt’s Palace Hotel wird im Rahmen des Rekrutierungsprozesses niemals Zahlungen oder finanzielle Informationen verlangen. Die gesamte offizielle Kommunikation erfolgt ausschliesslich über E-Mail-Adressen mit der Endung @badruttspalace.com.
Sollten Sie eine Zahlungsaufforderung oder eine verdächtige Nachricht erhalten, ignorieren Sie diese bitte und kontaktieren Sie uns direkt über unsere offizielle Website.
